positions.name: LiveRamp Holdings

Both boards approved, no financing conditions, expected close end-2026. Pre-market +26-27% to ~$37.30-37.59, leaving ~$1.20 (3.2%) deal-spread runway.

positions.name: Macy's Inc.
positions.exitRule: 1-3 day swing (+5% TP / -5% stop / Wed close)
